ruleDefinitions.name: SafeBoot Registry Key Deleted Via Reg.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "reg.exe" commands with the "delete" flag on safe boot registry keys. Often used by attacker to prevent safeboot execution of security products

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("reg\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "reg\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ delete\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\SYSTEM\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Control\\\\SafeBoot.*")))
